texto.es: Nos cuentas que pasa con tu techo: una filtracion, daño por tormenta o un reroof completo.
texto.en: Tell us what is going on with your roof: a leak, storm damage, or a full reroof.

texto.es: Carlos visita la propiedad, revisa el techo y te da un costo claro antes de empezar, sin letra chica.
texto.en: Carlos visits the property, checks the roof and gives you a clear cost before starting, no fine print.

texto.es: La misma cuadrilla se encarga del tear-off, la instalacion y la limpieza, de principio a fin.
texto.en: The same crew handles the tear-off, installation and cleanup, start to finish.

titulo.en: We walk it through with you

texto.es: Dejamos la propiedad limpia y revisamos el techo terminado contigo antes de irnos.
texto.en: We leave the property clean and walk the finished roof through with you before we go.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el tamano y el estado del techo; llamanos para una estimacion clara.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the roof's size and condition; call us for a clear estimate.

texto.es: Reemplazo completo de techos de teja o shingle, de tear-off a instalacion final, con limpieza incluida.
texto.en: Complete tile or shingle roof replacement, from tear-off to final installation, with cleanup included.

texto.es: Reparacion de tejas sueltas, shingle danado y areas puntuales sin necesidad de un reroof completo.
texto.en: Repair for loose tiles, damaged shingles and isolated spots without needing a full reroof.

texto.es: Identificamos el origen real de una filtracion antes de cotizar la reparacion, para no adivinar.
texto.en: We identify the real source of a leak before quoting the repair, so there is no guesswork.

texto.es: Evaluacion y reparacion de techos despues de tormentas y vientos fuertes, comunes en el sur de Florida.
texto.en: Roof assessment and repair after storms and high winds, common across South Florida.

pie.es: No ves exactamente lo que necesitas? Llamanos igual, la mayoria de nuestros trabajos empiezan con una llamada.
pie.en: Do not see exactly what you need? Call us anyway, most of our jobs start with a phone call.

items.quote: Carlos and his team are TOP NOTCH. We had a few companies come out to do our due diligence before going with a company. My husband and I were very impressed with the communication, transparency, and cost of our project.

Great company to work with from start to finish! Carlos was wonderful to work with. He is knowledgeable, responsive, and made sure everything was handled properly from beginning to end. The crew did a great job and left everything clean.

I rarely if ever fill out reviews on line but felt that I had to share my experience this time. I am so glad I chose Luna and Sons to do my reroof. They were so professional and the quality of the work was top notch!
